visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against local front, south aerial, northeast aerial, capital and statue photographs. The 26 outer Ionic columns, twelve-column portico and sixteen inner columns, stepped drum, shallow dome, broad stairs and open statue chamber are represented. Final review added the immediate raised terrace and connected its curved retaining wall to the main stair rails.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views and the full shared front image. Marble, granite and bronze retain their metric bindings; terrace grass is a separate local surface. The north-up overlay aligns the circular envelope and principal stairs. Shared flat ground is a material fixture; independent terrain is tested in the portable scene.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Distant levels retain 54 columns, portico, dome, broad stairs and terrace; closer levels restore Ionic volutes, dentils, fine joints and the simplified standing statue. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped dome, circular envelope, columns, north stairs and raised terrace establish plan and orientation. NPS counts correct incomplete mapped columns; HABS 1994 north elevation and longitudinal section control heights. Anchor [-77.03655391931534,38.88138293998067], heading pi; +X west and +Z north. Independent Terrarium heights are sampled unchanged into a 3 m review grid. Datum 3.4627 m at north approach [0,52], foundation -1 m. Wider gardens and Tidal Basin are excluded. Footprint suppression remains off; other host DEMs can differ.

fidelityReview.scope: Memorial exterior, immediate raised terrace, principal north stair flights and simplified standing Jefferson silhouette; wider gardens, basin, undercroft and detailed interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Original medium-fi exterior from inspected local Qualla photographs, NPS column counts and individually inspected HABS 1994 elevation and section. Geometry follows the measured 41 ft 0 7/8 in column height and approximately 95 ft 8 1/4 in main-floor-to-dome height. Ionic volutes, pediment figures, fine masonry, interior coffering and statue likeness are simplified; readable inscriptions and portrait fidelity are not claimed. No photo pixels are embedded.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets: 966 skyline, 3298 district, 15642 street and 63310 closeup triangles. Colonnade, portico, dome, terraces and stairs survive at distance. Fine joints, capital volutes, dentils and statue return progressively. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured mesh deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior from individually inspected Qualla photographs and HABS 1994 measured north elevation and longitudinal section; not a survey or photogrammetric reconstruction.

NPS establishes 26 outer, 12 portico and 16 inner columns. Map part counts and public rounded heights conflict; measured HABS proportions control the model. Fine volutes, dome masonry and hidden pier openings are simplified.

Main circular steps, north stair flight and immediate raised supporting terrace included; wider gardens, Tidal Basin, distant approachway, undercroft and modern accessibility equipment excluded. Vertical stair levels are approximate relative to the independent terrain contact.

Standing statue and pediment relief are original simplified silhouettes, not portrait-quality sculptures. Inscriptions, exact coffer pattern and detailed interiors are excluded; no photo pixels are embedded.
Independent terrain is preserved unchanged and foundation extends beneath it. Another host DEM can change exact ground contact.
